name: Python analysis
description: Run Python in a kernel shared by the composer and the agent, with inline output, a Variables pane and DataFrame tables.

items.name: py_run_cell
items.description: Run code in the workspace's kernel, the same one the user's composer uses; say why in intent.

items.name: py_restart
items.description: Restart the kernel, clearing its namespace.

items.name: py_variables
items.description: List the kernel's variables with type, shape and a short preview.

items.name: py_history
items.description: The session's cells in order, human and agent, with output and errors.

items.name: py_export
items.description: The session as a runnable # %% script or as JSON.

requires.install_hint: install Python 3; ipykernel and jupyter_client are optional (pip install ipykernel jupyter_client) and add IPython syntax
